annotations.title: Save a draft from a PDF

description: Fetch a PDF or page URL and save a draft form in the authenticated organization, the same way claiming a preview does. Requires an org API key with the forms:write scope. Uses the on-server parser only: Workers AI and other models stay off. Returns formId and editorUrl (/app/forms/{formId}). Does not publish the form. File contents are not logged.

url.description: https URL of a blank volunteer PDF.

name: create_form_from_pdf

parser.description: On-server parser. Workers AI stays off.
